steps.why: Each package of this demo in a default session of its own: it installs alone and is used. A package that needs a module default does not declare has nena enable it, as SDL2's audio@0 and touch@0.

steps.script: grep -qx audio@0 /etc/dolly/enabled && grep -qx touch@0 /etc/dolly/enabled && printf '%s\n' '#include <SDL.h>' 'int main(void) { SDL_Window *window; int failed = SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO) || !(window = SDL_CreateWindow("", 0, 0, 64, 48, 0)) || !SDL_CreateRenderer(window, -1, SDL_RENDERER_ACCELERATED); SDL_Quit(); return failed; }' > window.c && cc -O0 window.c $(pkg-config --cflags --static --libs sdl2) -o window && ./window

steps.why: SDL_mixer plays a short silent clip on a channel until it ends: SDL's audio driver pulls it.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <SDL.h>' '#include <SDL_mixer.h>' 'int main(void) { static Uint8 silence[48000 * 4 / 4]; if (SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO | SDL_INIT_AUDIO) != 0 || !SDL_CreateWindow("", 0, 0, 64, 48, 0) || Mix_OpenAudio(48000, AUDIO_S16SYS, 2, 1024) != 0) return 2; Mix_Chunk *chunk = Mix_QuickLoad_RAW(silence, sizeof silence); if (!chunk || Mix_PlayChannel(-1, chunk, 0) < 0) return 3; for (Uint32 start = SDL_GetTicks(); Mix_Playing(-1) && SDL_GetTicks() - start < 5000; SDL_Delay(10)) SDL_PumpEvents(); int ended = !Mix_Playing(-1); Mix_CloseAudio(); SDL_Quit(); return !ended; }' > /tmp/amy-mixer.c && cc $(pkg-config --cflags SDL2_mixer) /tmp/amy-mixer.c $(pkg-config --static --libs SDL2_mixer) -o /tmp/amy-mixer && /tmp/amy-mixer

steps.why: SDL_ttf renders a word in the terminal's font: the surface has ink.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <SDL_ttf.h>' 'int main(void) { SDL_Color white = { 255, 255, 255, 255 }; if (TTF_Init() != 0) return 2; TTF_Font *font = TTF_OpenFont("/usr/share/fonts/IosevkaTerm-SemiBold.ttf", 24); if (font == NULL) return 3; SDL_Surface *text = TTF_RenderUTF8_Blended(font, "Dolly", white); if (text == NULL || text->w < 40) return 4; Uint32 *pixel = text->pixels; int inked = 0; for (int i = 0; i < text->pitch / 4 * text->h; i++) inked += pixel[i] >> 24 > 128; return inked < 50; }' > /tmp/amy-ttf.c && cc $(pkg-config --cflags SDL2_ttf) /tmp/amy-ttf.c $(pkg-config --static --libs SDL2_ttf) -o /tmp/amy-ttf && /tmp/amy-ttf

steps.why: SDL_image writes a PNG and reads it back.

steps.script: mkdir /tmp/amy-image && cd /tmp/amy-image && printf '%s\n' '#include <SDL_image.h>' 'int main(void) { SDL_Surface *made = SDL_CreateRGBSurfaceWithFormat(0, 8, 8, 32, SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32); SDL_FillRect(made, NULL, SDL_MapRGBA(made->format, 200, 100, 50, 255)); if (IMG_SavePNG(made, "made.png") != 0) return 2; SDL_Surface *read = SDL_ConvertSurfaceFormat(IMG_Load("made.png"), SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32, 0); return read == NULL || read->w != 8 || ((Uint8 *)read->pixels)[0] != 200 || ((Uint8 *)read->pixels)[2] != 50; }' > image.c && cc -O0 image.c $(pkg-config --cflags --static --libs SDL2_image) -o image && ./image

steps.why: SDL2 with its X11 video driver, which fails to start where DISPLAY names no server.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <SDL.h>' '#include <string.h>' 'int main(int argc, char **argv) {' '  (void)argc;' '  (void)argv;' '  int x11 = 0;' '  for (int i = 0; i < SDL_GetNumVideoDrivers(); i++) x11 |= !strcmp(SDL_GetVideoDriver(i), "x11");' '  return x11 && SDL_VideoInit("x11") < 0 ? 0 : 1;' '}' > /tmp/amy-sdl2-x11.c && cc $(PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/lib/sdl2-x11/pkgconfig pkg-config --cflags sdl2) /tmp/amy-sdl2-x11.c -L/usr/lib/sdl2-x11 -lSDL2 -lXcursor -lXrandr -lXi -lXfixes -lXrender -lXext -lX11 -lxcb -lXau -ldolly-sockets -lm -o /tmp/amy-sdl2-x11 && /tmp/amy-sdl2-x11
